requirements.name: A word family is neither equivalence nor acquired sensory knowledge
requirements.classification: Authored lexicon with explicit distinctions; reader semantics must be traced
requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: File169 groups words under MEANS-SAME while its prose distinguishes degree, direction and manner: warm versus scalding, hard versus brittle, whisper versus shout. The title is not a license to substitute every group member. File173 explicitly warns that opposite words can keep the same company. The inspected ribbon loader builds sets from the groups, losing their written distinctions in that representation.
requirements.current_disposition: Authored dictionary/curriculum content is not intrinsically a violation. The vocabulary is not evidence of native acquired concepts. This particular ribbon reader never consumes its built sense sets, so the audit does not claim they currently decide a pupil response or that every table is executed.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Keep source-attributed teaching material external to the pupil. Bind each relation to its actual consumer and retained physical experience. Do not seed semantic equivalence, antonymy, degree or context into native memory or pretend a shared set preserves them.

requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: File171 mixes question forms, common words, rare-word descriptors, negation, courtesy and subject descriptors in MEANS-SAME lists. Language.__init__ marks every token from every such entry as an asking word, with later assignments overwriting earlier kinds. read() takes the kind of the first matching input token and removes all listed tokens from the subject. This is authored classification and filtering, not a sentence assembling its own language mechanism.
requirements.current_disposition: This is exact inspected source behavior conditional on these loaded entries, not proof the current ArcLoom pupil invokes it. The audit-only lexical receipt inventories the captured lists without importing the product; it is not a runtime acceptance test. Changing a list changes this classifier even if Python remains unchanged.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Exclude this classifier from pupil cognitive authority. Preserve the corpus and its historical failures for reconciliation. If retained as external tooling, label its scope and failure modes. Native roles, requests and contextual references must be acquired and retained through the approved sensory mechanism rather than repaired by more trigger words.

requirements.name: Crowd matching supplies authored context to the downstream answer
requirements.classification: Count-based selection, fixed threshold and lexical query expansion
requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: File172 supplies 44 authored subject crowds and repeatedly declares two words nearly certain. The reader counts subject/crowd overlap, takes a strictly greater count (earliest crowd survives a tie), requires two hits, and answer() adds the alphabetically first twelve crowd words to the carried query. These added words were not supplied by the current question or acquired by the pupil in this path.
requirements.current_disposition: The full downstream os_fabric consumer has not been closed in this slice, so no particular final answer or live interference is inferred. Subject token order is retained in the carried string; the finding is supplied lexical context and score authority, not a claim that this function alone flattens every representation.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Remove the count/tie/threshold/expansion route from pupil authority. Do not tune two to three or substitute another similarity score. Demonstrate native contextual discrimination using retained sensory relations; keep genuine external retrieval tools separately attributed if used outside the pupil.

requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: File170 stores SPLITS-INTO under sense labels such as money, river and tilt, each followed by bank and contextual words. The loader keys these entries by the first token of the label, rather than bank, merges them with MEANS-SAME sets, and never reads self.senses in read() or answer(). Its header nevertheless says it settles which sense is meant and reads the language files at the moment of each question. The global LANG object is built once and has no refresh path in this file.
requirements.current_disposition: The built .senses table is unused by this complete inspected module. Other consumers/dynamic access remain to inventory; no blanket repository-wide dead-code conclusion is made. core refreshing its own entries does not rebuild this Language object. The actual current serving use of either is unknown.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Correct the mechanism inventory and claims before any acceptance. Do not wire the unused dictionary into the pupil to make the advertised behavior appear. Prove the lawful native ambiguity mechanism separately; inventory snapshot/version coherence for any permitted external tool.

requirements.name: The reader loses distinctions its own language documents require
requirements.classification: Source/document contradiction with bounded static counterexamples
requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: File171 says negation reverses the requested answer, then calls bread/rising the whole question after stripping not. The reader removes listed negations from its carried subject; asked/kind metadata is not passed by answer() to deliver(). Its letters-only tokenizer discards numeric values, so changing 200C to 300C leaves the same lexical material. File173 demands number-plus-unit fidelity and warns about negation, quotation, hypothetical claims and direction. The separate core masks additionally discard word order and polarity as previously documented.
requirements.current_disposition: The independent receipt checks text projection only; it does not run the organism or assert all system representations lose order. The contradiction is not fixed by retaining raw text in a receipt if the decision consumer still receives the reduced projection. File173’s requirement that an answer add new words is also an invalid universal acceptance predicate: a correct choice may repeat an offered alternative.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Specify the actual physical/retained distinctions needed for roles, quantities, negation, source attribution and temporal context. Prove they reach and influence the decision consumer. Retire the symbolic filtering authority rather than add exception lists, synthetic polarity flags or word-novelty scoring to emulate understanding.

requirements.name: Human language descriptions are requirements and curriculum, not native mechanism proofs
requirements.classification: Unqualified generalizations; preserve channel and context distinctions
requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: Deep-language89 describes role order, temporal perspective, modality, emphasis, speaker attribution, shared context, turn-taking, repair and signed language. These identify distinctions a language claim must handle. It also declares broad developmental and impossibility rules, including that word boundaries cannot be learned without already knowing words and that children supply missing grammar. The text supplies no ArcLoom state/update/retention/consumer design proving those claims apply to this substrate.
requirements.current_disposition: This is reconciliation of what the documents assert, not independent validation of their biological/linguistic science. No scientific claim here establishes a universal barrier to native speech or a guarantee of emergence. The useful requirement for a live return path is distinct from proof that the pupil acquired or used it.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Preserve the linguistic distinctions as explicit claim-specific requirements. Authenticate external scientific sources before importing calibration or universal laws. Map each claimed native ability to retained sensory/body/context state and its later causal use; keep unsupported capabilities visibly unqualified.

requirements.name: Recover removed constraints and greeting-rule changes without restoring the wrong authority
requirements.classification: Historical policy migration, explicit failure lessons and authored output
requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: Across these seven families, earlier versions contain 347 unique older-only passages totaling943 lines, predominantly removed CANNOT claims. The question family includes different greeting rules and ready-made CHUNKS (hello/morning/hi/good to see you/I am here/go on). The latest retains the broad MEANS-SAME lists. The inspected old core consumes CANNOT prose as rules, while saying.py separately builds authored greeting responses. Removing headings or moving policy between prose, chunks and Python changes authority; it is not automatically a semantic repair.
requirements.current_disposition: All17 captured versions are content-reconciled. These are historical source transitions, not a deployment receipt or proof that every removed prohibition was sound. Some prohibitions are overbroad; blindly restoring all943 lines would reintroduce wrong policy. A documented retraction is useful evidence, not qualification of its successor.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Preserve predecessor content, original decisions and counterexamples. Distinguish genuine correction, corpus editorial change, behavior change and unsupported replacement. Retire authored pupil replies rather than move them into data; any allowed external greeting/tool must remain attributed and outside learned-speech evidence.

requirements.name: Programming-language curriculum cannot waive proof or resource accounting
requirements.classification: External subject matter with unsupported universal bounds; not governing instructions
requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: Programming-language126 is general curriculum rather than an ArcLoom design. It asserts all languages compute the same things, discusses domain-limited languages, and makes broad statements about unavoidable costs, type safety, concurrency and foreign-code boundaries. Its older text says no auditing all transitive dependencies. These claims do not bind the actual deployed architecture, prove a latency floor or excuse incomplete ML/heuristic exclusion.
requirements.current_disposition: The audit does not adopt the text’s universal claims as computer-science theorems or current operational instructions. Actual bounds depend on the specified implementation and workload. The file’s presence in the language corpus does not establish speech execution, an ML dependency or a live causal fault.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Classify this material as external curriculum and authenticate any claim used in engineering. Derive resource bounds from the actual native/source path and account for its complete executable dependencies. Keep design gaps explicit; never substitute an unrelated broad theorem for current measurement.
